sentence_stem: Never before had the team faced such a challenge,
correct_completion: so they asked the manager for extra time.
full_sentence: Never before had the team faced such a challenge, so they asked the manager for extra time.
acceptable_variants: so they requested more time from the manager.
so they asked for help from the other departments.

options.text: and they had always enjoyed easy tasks.
options.why_wrong: The stem stresses a new, hard challenge. This option describes an easy routine, which does not fit the emphasis of 'never before'.

options.text: but the team had already finished the project.
options.why_wrong: The stem sets up an unfamiliar difficulty, so a completed project does not follow logically from it.

options.text: so they asked the manager for extra time.
because the weather was very cold.
options.why_wrong: 'Because' introduces a cause unrelated to the challenge. The sentence needs a logical reaction to the challenge.

grammar_focus: Fronted negative adverbials with subject-auxiliary inversion
explanation: After a fronted negative adverbial such as 'never before', the auxiliary is inverted, and the main clause must give a logical result of the stated challenge.
translation: Ніколи раніше команда не стикалася з таким викликом, тому вони попросили у менеджера додатковий час.
